# GUI Interface Description

## System Header Bar
- **Left Side**: "Activities" button
- **Center**: "Files" title
- **Right Side**: 
  - Date and time: "Oct 22 21:26"
  - Notification bell icon
  - System status icons (network, sound, power)

## Desktop Background
- Abstract geometric wallpaper with gradient of purple to red hues
- Visual element resembling a stylized feather or abstract shape in the center-right area

## Left Sidebar Navigation
- **Recent**: Section with clock icon
- **Starred**: Section with star icon
- **Home**: Section with house icon, currently selected
- **Desktop**: Section with desktop icon
- **Documents**: Section with document icon
- **Downloads**: Section with download icon
- **Music**: Section with music note icon
- **Pictures**: Section with picture icon
- **Videos**: Section with video camera icon
- **Trash**: Section with trash can icon
- **Other Locations**: Section with plus icon

## File Explorer Window
- **Title Bar**: "Home" with house icon
- **Navigation Controls**: 
  - Back arrow
  - Forward arrow
  - Address bar showing "Home"
  - Three-dot menu button
  - Search magnifying glass icon
- **View Options**: 
  - List view button
  - Dropdown for view options
  - Grid view button
  - Minimize button
  - Maximize button
  - Close button (X)

## File and Folder Grid
- **Top Row**:
  - Desktop (folder icon with gradient)
  - Documents (folder icon with document)
  - Downloads (folder icon with download arrow)
  - Music (folder icon with musical note)
  - Pictures (folder icon with image)
  - Public (folder icon with share symbol)
  - requirements.txt (text file icon)
- **Second Row**:
  - server (folder icon)
  - snap (folder icon)
  - Templates (folder icon with document)
  - Videos (folder icon with video)
  - .bash_history (text file icon)
  - .bash_logout (text file icon)
  - .bashrc (text file icon)
- **Third Row**:
  - .cache (folder icon)
  - .config (folder icon)
  - .gnupg (folder icon)
  - .ipython (folder icon)
  - .lesshst (text file icon)
  - .local (folder icon)
  - .mozilla (folder icon)
- **Fourth Row**:
  - .pki (folder icon)
  - .profile (text file icon)
  - .selected_editor (text file icon)
  - .ssh (folder icon)
  - .sudo_as_admin_successful (text file icon)
  - thunderbird (folder icon)
  - .var (folder icon)
- **Fifth Row**:
  - .viminfo (text file icon)
  - .vscode (folder icon)

## Desktop Icons
- **Bottom Right Corner**: 
  - "Home" folder icon with house symbol
  - "Home" label below the icon

## Left Dock
- **Top to Bottom**:
  - Google Chrome icon
  - Thunderbird email client icon
  - Visual Studio Code icon
  - VLC media player icon
  - LibreOffice Writer icon
  - LibreOffice Calc icon
  - LibreOffice Impress icon
  - GIMP image editor icon
  - Files application icon (currently active)
  - Ubuntu Software icon
  - Help icon (question mark)
  - Trash icon
  - Grid icon for application launcher

## System Tray
- Located in the top-right corner of the screen
- Contains system status icons (network, sound, power)
